name: WPSOLR — One plugin. All the best search & recommendation engines.
author: WPSOLR

sections.faq:
What is WPSOLR?

WPSOLR is a WordPress and WooCommerce search plugin that connects your website to powerful search engines and recommendation technologies. It helps deliver more relevant search results, advanced filtering, semantic search, and product recommendations.

Which brands and agencies use WPSOLR?

WPSOLR is used by hundreds of brands, agencies and organizations across ecommerce, publishing, education and other industries. Some with millions of products and millions of monthly visits.

View brands and agencies

Does WPSOLR work with WooCommerce?

Yes. WPSOLR is built for WooCommerce and can index products, categories, attributes, SKUs, prices, custom fields, and other product data.

Which search and recommendation engines does WPSOLR support?

WPSOLR connects WordPress and WooCommerce to leading search and AI technologies, including:

  • PostgreSQL AI
  • OpenSearch
  • Weaviate AI
  • Vespa AI
  • Elasticsearch
  • Apache Solr

Each technology has different strengths. WPSOLR gives you the flexibility to choose the search or AI technology that best fits your website, data, traffic and search requirements.

Do WPSOLR handles large WooCommerce catalogs?

Yes. WPSOLR is designed for large WordPress websites and WooCommerce stores, including catalogs with millions of products. Search can be handled by dedicated search infrastructure instead of your WordPress database.

Can I use WPSOLR with my existing search engine?

Yes. You can connect WPSOLR to your own supported search infrastructure.

Does WPSOLR replace the default WordPress search?

Yes. WPSOLR can replace the standard WordPress search with search powered by a dedicated search engine, while adding features such as relevance tuning, autocomplete, faceted navigation, and semantic search.

Does WPSOLR support faceted search?

Yes. WPSOLR supports faceted search and advanced filters based on categories, taxonomies, attributes, custom fields, prices, dates, and other indexed data.

Does WPSOLR support semantic and AI search?

Yes. WPSOLR can connect WordPress and WooCommerce to vector and AI search technologies to provide semantic search and more relevant results.

Can WPSOLR provide product recommendations?

Yes. WPSOLR can connect WooCommerce stores to recommendation technologies to provide relevant product recommendations based on product data and customer behavior.

Can WPSOLR index custom post types and custom fields?

Yes. WPSOLR can index WordPress posts, pages, custom post types, taxonomies, custom fields, and WooCommerce data.

Does WPSOLR support multilingual websites?

Yes. WPSOLR can be used with multilingual WordPress websites and supported multilingual plugins.

Do I need to install a search engine myself?

Yes. WPSOLR connects your WordPress or WooCommerce website to a search engine or recommendation technology. You need to provide access to a supported search service or search infrastructure.

WPSOLR handles the WordPress and WooCommerce integration, indexing and search configuration, while the underlying search technology runs on the infrastructure you choose.

Where can I learn more about WPSOLR integrations?

You can learn how WPSOLR works with different search and AI technologies through our video playlists:

  • Shorts explaining Weaviate
  • Shorts explaining Vespa.ai
  • Shorts explaining Elasticsearch
  • WPSOLR Channel containing 100 demos and use cases
